note: content_sha256 = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON rows (sorted keys); independent of the Parquet encoder

papers.name: id
papers.description: Stable bibliography id: 'doi:<lowercase DOI>' or 'nodoi:<16 hex>' (sha256 of folded first-author surname|year|folded title or printed reference). Primary key.

papers.name: key
papers.description: URL-safe file key: 'p' + first 16 hex of sha256(id). Record at papers/<key>.json, page at pages/papers/<key>.html.

papers.name: doi
papers.description: DOI in lower case (empty when the work has none).

papers.name: no_doi
papers.description: True when the work has no DOI and the id is derived from first author, year and title.

papers.name: title
papers.description: Title (Crossref; for works without a Crossref record: the title held by ORCHID's sources, may be empty).

papers.name: authors
papers.description: Authors as 'Given Family', '; '-joined, in Crossref order.

papers.name: orcids
papers.description: ORCID iDs deposited with Crossref for the authors, '; '-joined.

papers.name: container_title
papers.description: Journal, book or proceedings title.

papers.name: volume
papers.description: Volume.

papers.name: issue
papers.description: Issue.

papers.name: pages
papers.description: Page range or article number.

papers.name: year
papers.description: Publication year (Crossref 'issued'; otherwise as printed).

papers.name: publisher
papers.description: Publisher (Crossref).

papers.name: type
papers.description: Crossref work type (journal-article, book-chapter, ...).

papers.name: metadata_source
papers.description: Where the bibliographic fields come from: 'crossref', or the ORCHID source that printed the reference (orchid_literature_printed_reference, tdb_header, handbook_reference, discovery_snapshot, ...).

papers.name: citation
papers.description: One-line citation built from the metadata (printed reference for works without a Crossref record).

papers.name: systems
papers.description: Chemical systems the work covers in ORCHID (sorted element symbols joined by '-'), ';'-joined. Discovery leads contribute only systems named in their title.

papers.name: roles
papers.description: Roles in ORCHID, ';'-joined: corpus_assessment_read, cited_original_source, tdb_source_assessment, tdb_compilation, handbook_diagram_source, discovery_lead, context_source, espei_reference.

papers.name: tdb_files
papers.description: TDB files whose header cites this work as the assessment (tdb_source_assessment), ';'-joined.

papers.name: handbook_systems
papers.description: Systems whose assessed (handbook) diagram names this work as its source, ';'-joined.

papers.name: discovery_rank
papers.description: Rank in the Crossref higher-order assessment discovery (discovery_lead).

papers.name: values_reported
papers.description: Literature values ORCHID read from this paper (all released records, accepted or not).

papers.name: values_reported_accepted
papers.description: Of those, values with flags.extraction_accepted.

papers.name: values_reported_experimental
papers.description: Values read from this paper with evidence class experimental.

papers.name: values_reported_model
papers.description: ... evidence class model.

papers.name: values_reported_dft
papers.description: ... evidence class dft.

papers.name: values_reported_unspecified
papers.description: ... evidence class unspecified.

papers.name: values_cited
papers.description: Values in other papers whose printed source (cited_sources) is this work.

papers.name: values_cited_accepted
papers.description: Of those, accepted values.

papers.name: property_groups
papers.description: Property groups of the values reported in or citing this work, ';'-joined.

papers.name: properties
papers.description: Property codes (HM_FORM, INVARIANT_TEMPERATURE, ...) of those values, ';'-joined.

papers.name: n_tables
papers.description: Distinct tables of this paper the released values come from.

papers.name: n_text_passages
papers.description: Distinct sentences (running-text quotes) of this paper the released values come from.

papers.name: n_espei_datasets
papers.description: ESPEI datasets of the ORCHID bundle derived from values of this work (paths in papers.jsonl).

papers.name: n_phase_registry_phases
papers.description: Phase-registry phases that cite this work (paper label or reference).

papers.name: n_assessed_assemblage_records
papers.description: Assessed phase-assemblage records whose original evaluation is this work.

papers.name: open_access_license
papers.description: First Creative Commons licence URL in the Crossref license field (empty: none deposited). Never inferred from elsewhere.

papers.name: license_urls
papers.description: Every licence URL in the Crossref license field (TDM, publisher, CC), ';'-joined.

papers.name: is_referenced_by_count
papers.description: Crossref is-referenced-by-count on the retrieval date.

papers.name: is_referenced_by_count_retrieved
papers.description: Date the Crossref record was retrieved.

papers.name: crossref_status
papers.description: found | not_found (404 at Crossref) | no_doi | not_fetched.

papers.name: doi_check
papers.description: consistent | mismatch_suspect: Crossref first author / year / title compared with the reference printed in ORCHID's source (empty: nothing printed to compare).

papers.name: read_by_orchid
papers.description: yes: ORCHID processed the paper's full text in its extraction corpus; no otherwise.

papers.name: edges_out
papers.description: Edges with this paper as src (edges.*).

papers.name: edges_in
papers.description: Edges with this paper as dst.

papers.name: json_url
papers.description: Resolvable JSON record of this paper.

papers.name: html_url
papers.description: Static HTML page of this paper.

edges.name: id
edges.description: Stable edge id: 'e' + first 16 hex of sha256(type|src|dst|provenance source). Primary key.

edges.name: type
edges.description: cites | used_in_assessment | models_system_in_tdb | reassesses | handbook_reproduces | cited_by_crossref.

edges.name: src
edges.description: Source node id (paper id, or handbook:okamoto-2010:<SYS> for handbook_reproduces).

edges.name: dst
edges.description: Target node id (paper id, or tdb:<file> for models_system_in_tdb).

edges.name: count
edges.description: cites / used_in_assessment: number of values carrying that citation.

edges.name: provenance_source
edges.description: orchid_extraction | crossref_reference_list | sgte_tdb_header | orchid_literature_model_link | verified_assessment | okamoto_handbook_source_line | citation+same-system.

edges.name: provenance_dataset
edges.description: Input the edge was read from.

edges.name: attrs
edges.description: Remaining attributes as compact JSON (evidence-class and citation-status counts, TDB sha256, page, ...).
